'''Shadow Vision''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that was formulated by the [[Disciples of Twilight]]. Users of the ability could use the Force to gain low-light vision, allowing them to ignore the concealment (but not total concealment) of darkness. This only lasted for a short period of time.
